pages.text: There are a few drinks in Moon's Whatsits, mostly made from ingredients you can grow yourself.$(br2)There are fruit juices, Strawberry Smoothies and Coffee.

pages.title: Drinks
pages.text: The drinks added by the mod are Apple Juice, Cherry Juice, Coffee and Strawberry Smoothie.$(br2)They're all served in glass bottles and can be drank like other drinks.
Crafting:$\(br\)Apple Juice: Apple + Glass Bottle$\(br\)Cherry Juice: Cherry + Glass Bottle$\(br\)Coffee: Coffee Beans + Water Bottle$\(br\)Strawberry Smoothie: Strawberries + Milk Bucket + Sugar.
